sections.h2: Software and hardware's share of inflow rose from 7.4% to 22.7%

chart.title: Software and hardware took about a fifth of inflow once the later period began
chart.sub: Share of each period's FDI equity inflow, %.
chart.source: DPIIT sector tables (data.gov.in); DPIIT fact sheet to June 2026.

sections.means: Software and hardware went from 7.4% of inflow to 22.7%, and held at 19.5% in the last three years.
sections.todo: DPIIT should publish sector totals for every year, so nobody has to subtract the tables to get the shares.

sections.h2: Townships and housing fell from 7.3% of inflow to 0.7% and stayed there

chart.title: The biggest loser of the early years took under 1% of inflow after 2017
chart.sub: Share of each period's FDI equity inflow, %.
chart.source: DPIIT sector tables (data.gov.in); DPIIT fact sheet to June 2026.

sections.means: Townships, housing and built-up infrastructure fell from $24.3 billion before April 2017 to about $2.1 billion after.
sections.todo: DPIIT should publish sector totals for every year, with a note on any figures it restates.

sections.h2: Average yearly inflow rose from $19.5 billion to $54.1 billion

chart.title: The average year more than doubled, and rose again in the latest three years
chart.sub: Average FDI equity inflow a year, US$ billion.
chart.source: DPIIT sector tables (data.gov.in); DPIIT fact sheet to June 2026.

sections.means: The yearly average rose from $19.5 billion to about $50.1 billion, then to $54.1 billion in the latest period.
sections.todo: Read the sector shares as subtraction-based until DPIIT publishes annual sector figures for every year.
